title: Surreal Heart Weaver
description: A dark-haired woman in traditional embroidered attire sits on a teal couch, writing in an open book while holding a glowing anatomical heart in her left hand. A large stylized mouth emerges from a patterned wall, releasing a swirling red and cream ribbon filled with floating babies that wraps through the surreal scene.
prompt: A surreal scene of a dark-haired woman in green traditional embroidered dress sitting on a teal vintage couch, writing in a book with a quill. She holds a glowing red anatomical heart in one hand. A large stylized open mouth emerges from a blue patterned wall, spewing a swirling red and cream ribbon populated with many floating babies. On the wooden table are framed pictures of bleeding hearts in bowls, roses, and embroidered textiles. Cinematic lighting, highly detailed symbolic artwork.
